title: Add coverage-weighted evaluation harness and stable-delta reporter
author: Asha Patel
description:
Context and motivation: Our existing CI gating uses aggregate metrics that treat every prompt equally which underweights long-tail coverage issues and makes small distributional shifts noisy. This PR introduces a coverage-weighted evaluation harness and a stable-delta reporter to (1) surface regressions concentrated in undercovered prompt cohorts, (2) reduce false positives from high-variance short cohorts, and (3) provide a compact delta artifact for CI that is robust to nondeterministic seeds. The description below summarizes design, changes, and operational notes.

What this delivers: coverage-weighted scoring: per-prompt weights derived from historical sample counts and semantic-diversity scores; cohort-aware aggregation that downweights unstable micro-cohorts; stable-delta reporter: deterministic summarization of before/after evals using bootstrap-smoothed deltas + significance bucketing; a small integration layer and a CI reporter that emits a machine-parsable artifact for the PR pipeline.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-1145) [x] unit tests for weighting logic [x] e2e smoke pipeline runs in CI [x] docs/guide for teams to adopt the reporter [x] added metrics and trace spans for debugging

Commits summary: - 9 commits: initial weighting algorithm + tests; add bootstrap smoothing utils; implement stable-delta reporter CLI; wire into github CI reporter; add semantic-diversity scorer (fast, approximate); docs and examples; refactor eval runner to accept optional weight maps; fix edge-case on zero-count cohorts; final test fixes and plugin registration.

Changed areas (high level): - eval_harness/core/weighting.py: new weighting primitives and heuristics for coverage and diversity - eval_harness/reporting/stable_delta.py: new reporter that produces compact JSON deltas and human summary - eval_harness/cli/report_ci.py: CI entrypoint to run targeted evals and emit artifacts - tests/unit/test_weighting.py, tests/integration/test_stable_delta_end_to_end.py - docs/guides/coverage_weighting.md - examples/coverage_demo/prompt_set.yaml

Operational notes: The weighting defaults are conservative (weight floor 0.02) so small cohorts are visible but cannot dominate the aggregated score. The stable-delta reporter outputs both a human-readable summary and a compressed artifact (.json.gz) that CI uploads as an artifact. The reporter includes a deterministic seed and a small bootstrap sweep (default 50 resamples) to smooth noisy per-prompt metrics; runtime overhead observed in smoke runs: ~6% extra time for 2k prompt sets on a 16-core worker.

CI run summary: First CI run failed style/lint on one minor import ordering; subsequent runs passed all checks including unit tests and integration smoke. The PR attaches the CI artifact for the final successful run.

Merge notes: After two approvals and one small follow-up hotfix to doc wording, this PR was squash-merged into main. Release notes include a short adoption guide and recommended defaults.

References: Linear ENG-1145 (Coverage-weighted eval prototype), PM-321 (QA gating for prompt-sets).

release_notes: Adds coverage-weighted eval aggregation and a stable-delta CI reporter. Teams can opt-in by providing a weight map or using the default heuristic; recommended for prompt sets with long-tail cohorts.
